159451a1.text:
You dial yourself up every morning.

The switch says: what is that hum?

I’m calling for myself. The humming is not my own,

2a28f8e3.text: But what is not my own, but seems my own?

5e42a5b1.text: That hum is what you do when you are on your way out.

5201402d.text: Your humming is the sound of your soul

b7ee3517.text: And if you listen you will hear it coming back to you.

7e10518f.text: You hear it now, you hear it soon enough.

ff1e6297.text: It’s always coming home to you.

85a06ea4.text: When you look in the mirror, you see yourself,

ddebaa35.text: Your face is always smiling. It’s always there.

6e4f6601.text: So close it feels like your smile is there too.

ec5f2a27.text: You call and answer the phone.

c91a9914.text: But no one answers, the voice is gone.

e01022c2.text: But it’s always there, when you want it.

d9bc1458.text: You know where your house is. You know your keys and your

733675d8.text: Lipstick. You know how to call your family and friends.

8fba720f.text: You know what day of the week it is.

5955a39b.text: And you know you will be on time.

4f71cfe0.text: You are right on time, it’s your time.

3294751b.text: You have a voice that says: "you know it's a lie".

397f8ee2.text: Your voice is the sound of the truth.

98539170.text: And it calls you by your name, even though you are not here.
